plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the official 2026-2027 AAC Academic Catalog, 'Master of Arts in Art Education Sample Schedule' (30 credit hours). The program is traditionally completed over three eight-week summer sessions; the catalog also allows accelerated (academic-year augmentation), extended (four or five summers), or custom schedules approved by the MAAE Program Chair. A total of 9 credit hours of Art Education Seminar coursework is required (four two-credit seminars plus the one-credit Portfolio Presentation). The seminar options are the 2-credit MA5xxx seminars in the catalog course descriptions. transfer_confidence is 'core_only': AAC is a private art college with no published TCCNS/articulation equivalencies, so tccns mirrors the local course code.
